name: SMRITI Allocation Audit Snapshot

fields.label: Receipt Item Row Ref
fields.description: MUST store the Purchase Receipt Item child row's stable Frappe 'name' (internal unique identifier), NEVER a positional/display row number. A positional index can shift meaning after reordering or edits, breaking permanent traceability -- this is the entire purpose of this field.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Self-describing audit record. Same-currency is enforced at document level today; this field avoids ambiguity if that rule evolves later.

fields.label: Method Used
fields.description: Snapshot of the allocation_basis applied to THIS specific cost component at run time -- not a document-level value, since different cost lines may use different bases.

_spec_reference: SMRITI_Landed_Cost_Spec_v1.md Section 3.2, Revision D. Grain: one row per (Purchase Receipt Item Row x Cost Component) pair. Populated ONCE on submit by the allocation service controller hook; immutable thereafter -- no app-level edit UI, no recompute path. See validation spec for the on_submit population logic.
